Since embed_category was removed from site_settings.yml with a blank default, a fresh install has no such row, so the INNER JOIN query returns an empty result; indexing [0] yields nil (or raises IndexError), and `['id']`/`.to_i` fails, aborting the migration before the embeddable_hosts data copy. The mechanism is verifiable directly from the diff and is a real defect.
